title: sitePerfectOverMapComp
statement:
For a ring sheaf R and composable arrows g:W→V and f:V→U, the composite of module restrictions along f then g is canonically isomorphic to restriction along g≫f.

Precise quantified statement:
def sitePerfectOverMapComp
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    (R : Sheaf J RingCat.{r}) {U V W : C} (f : V ⟶ U) (g : W ⟶ V) :
    overMap.{max u v r} R f ⋙ overMap R g ≅ overMap R (g ≫ f)

Notions used: [def-weil-pbc-strict-perfect-coefficient-package], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], [def-pur-localized-ringed-site].
